parse.title: Value List
parse.text:
This List is only to be used as a Guide and not to base 100% of your trades off of

Overview

This page classifies different units into various ranks based on their overall value in most trades, Keep in mind that the rankings are not completely indicative of your trades - some may get overpays and some may not. This is simply used as a Guide to your trades. This tierlist is not final and is always subject to change.

Last Update: 3/14/2025 (March 14th 2025)
